name: BCF

physics_goals.quote: The main goals of the BCF (Bologna, CERN, Frascati) were the measurement of the pion and K mesons form factors, and the search for heavy leptons.
physics_goals.value: Pion and kaon form factors and a search for heavy leptons

summary.plain: One of the four first experiments at Frascati's ADONE collider (1969), run by Bologna, CERN and Frascati. It measured pion and kaon form factors, searched for heavy leptons and in 1971 gave the final demonstration that the multiple production was hadronic.
summary.technical: BCF (Bologna-CERN-Frascati) at ADONE (first generation, 1969): scintillation counters and spark chambers with careful calibration; pion and kaon form factors, heavy-lepton search (limits on new lepton masses); 1971 demonstration that the anomalous multiple production was hadrons.
